skill.description: Create and refine Roblox R6 and R15 character animations in Blender through a guided workflow. The skill supports rig checks, animation polishing, exports, and GIF previews.
skill.summary: Create and validate Roblox R6 and R15 animations in Blender.

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Blender keyframe terminology, documentation backticks, audit rules, and guarded asset handling. One high-risk capability is confirmed: the skill executes hash-pinned Python text blocks from a Blender file. No prompt-injection language or evidence of data exfiltration was found in the reviewed context.

remediation.issue: Embedded Blender text blocks are compiled and executed.
remediation.suggestion: Replace embedded-script execution with a reviewed bundled implementation where possible. If retained, document the exact trusted hashes, require explicit user confirmation, and run it in a restricted Blender environment.

remediation.issue: The workflow downloads and enables third-party animation assets.
remediation.suggestion: Keep source allowlists and SHA-256 pins current, show users the asset origin and hash before use, and require confirmation before downloads or add-on activation.

content.value_statement: Creating polished Roblox character animation requires compatible rigs, clear motion checks, and correct exports. This skill guides Blender-based R6 and R15 animation work from rig validation to preview delivery.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of full-body Roblox R6 and R15 actions in Blender.
Checks rig structure and animation readiness before editing.
Helps inspect keyframes, contact intervals, and loop continuity.
Guides curve polishing to reduce robotic movement and foot sliding.
Supports export planning for rbxanim or FBX workflows.
Creates a GIF preview workflow from rendered animation frames.
limitations: Requires Blender and a compatible Roblox rig or Studio workflow.
Cannot guarantee that third-party rigs, add-ons, or downloads are safe.
Output quality depends on the source rig, references, and user review.
Roblox Studio publishing and final platform testing remain user responsibilities.

use_cases.title: Build a player movement set
use_cases.description: Create a walk, run, idle, and jump set with consistent timing and contact checks.

use_cases.title: Polish an existing action
use_cases.description: Review curves and poses to improve an imported attack, emote, or loop.

use_cases.title: Prepare an animation handoff
use_cases.description: Validate exports and produce a preview GIF with notes for implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: create an idle
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a 24-frame Roblox R15 idle in Blender. Check the rig first, then give me a clear pose and review plan.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: improve a walk
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect my Roblox R6 walk cycle for foot sliding and abrupt curves. Recommend specific pose, timing, and Graph Editor changes.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: export a combat action
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through validating this Roblox rig, polishing a non-looping sword attack, and exporting the named action with an auditable frame range.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: review a handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the final Roblox animation workflow. List required validation checks, export notes, and GIF preview requirements before handoff.

best_practices: Use a saved working copy before changing a rig or animation.
Inspect third-party Blender files and add-ons before enabling them.
Review exported animation playback in the target Roblox workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite the only copy of a source rig.
Do not enable untrusted Blender scripts without inspection.
Do not rely only on a GIF preview for final Roblox validation.

faq.question: Does this skill create R6 and R15 animations?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides animation workflows for Roblox R6 and R15 rigs.

faq.question: Do I need Blender?
faq.answer: Yes. Blender is required for the described rig and animation workflow.

faq.question: Can it publish animations to Roblox?
faq.answer: No. You must complete Roblox Studio publishing and testing yourself.

faq.question: Does it support third-party rigs?
faq.answer: It can inspect them, but compatibility and safety are not guaranteed.

faq.question: Can it help reduce foot sliding?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes contact and curve review guidance for grounded motion.

faq.question: Why should I create a GIF preview?
faq.answer: A preview makes it easier to review timing and visible motion before handoff.
